title: Case-goods brand importing dressers into New Jersey
assumptions: A brand importing wood dressers through New Jersey, with no store (the seller path). The company and tax filings are those of heldout/edison-bakery.json (New Jersey's formation and NJ-REG); the import filings are the library's; the furniture filings and facts are read from APHIS, EPA and CPSC on 2026-10-21. Dressers are clothing storage units on CPSC's page, so 16 CFR part 1261 applies; nothing upholstered is named, so no California or upholstered-furniture rule appears.
